1756.sourceName: Legion Alchemy - Transmute: Meat to Pet / Growling Sac
1756.instructions: Learn Legion Alchemy from Deucus Valdera in Broken Isles Dalaran (41.3, 33.4). Complete the alchemy-station quest chain through Return the Filter, then buy Recipe: Wild Transmutation from Patricia Egan in the same shop (42.2, 32.3). Perform Wild Transmutation at the Dalaran Alchemy Station each day until you discover Transmute: Meat to Pet. Use that recipe to make a Pulsating Sac and wait 7 real-time days for it to become a Growling Sac. Open it for a random pet; Ridgeback Piglet is one possible result. Repeat if needed, or buy a caged Ridgeback Piglet on the Auction House.

1886.sourceName: Legion Engineering - Halls of Valor: Trigger Happy
1886.instructions: Learn Legion Engineering in Broken Isles Dalaran and follow the engineering story until Hobart Grapplehammer offers Halls of Valor: Trigger Happy. Accept it at the engineering shop (38.4, 24.7), defeat Odyn in Halls of Valor and loot the Runestone of Vitality. Return to Hobart to learn Trigger. Craft it at Legion Engineering 90 with 50 Leystone Ore, 30 Loose Trigger, 20 Oversized Blasting Cap, 2 Sniping Scope, 50 Blood of Sargeras and 10 Infernal Brimstone. You can instead buy a caged Trigger from another player or the Auction House without Engineering.

1806.sourceName: Blingtron 6000 Gift Package - portable daily gift / Reaves engineering unlock
1806.instructions: Accept Blingtron 6000's daily gift quest and open the Blingtron 6000 Gift Package for a chance at Knockoff Blingtron. Another player's Blingtron works; it is portable and has no permanent spawn. To summon your own, progress Legion Engineering with Didi the Wrench in Broken Isles Dalaran (38.6, 25.0), complete Short Circuit and Oil Rags to Riches, craft Reaves Module: Bling Mode and install it on Reaves. Summon Reaves with a battery and choose Bling Mode. The marker follows this engineering unlock route, not a fixed Blingtron spawn. Alternatively, buy a caged pet on the Auction House.
1806.locationType: Optional engineering unlock for your own portable Blingtron

2117.sourceName: Legion Herbalism - herb nodes on Argus
2117.instructions: Learn Legion Herbalism, unlock Argus through The Hand of Fate and follow the Argus campaign to open its zones. Gather herbs in Krokuun, Antoran Wastes or Eredath: Fel-Encrusted Herb nodes and Astral Glory can yield Fel Lasher. Keep gathering; this is a rare bonus from harvesting herbs, not a wild pet you trap or a stationary creature drop. The map opens the actual gathering zones because herb nodes move and respawn. You can also buy a caged Fel Lasher from another player or the Auction House.

2121.sourceName: Legion Skinning - skinnable creatures on Argus
2121.instructions: Learn Legion Skinning and unlock Argus through The Hand of Fate. Kill and skin beasts on Argus for a rare chance at Fossorial Bile Larva; the pet comes from skinning, not their normal loot or pet battles. One reported farm is Chitinbuk Ruinwalkers in Eredath around 52.0, 35.0. Panthara in Krokuun's Petrified Forest and other skinnable Argus beasts are alternatives. Keep skinning until the pet drops, or buy a caged copy on the Auction House. The marker is a farming area, not a guaranteed pet spawn; Fiendish Leather ranks improve material yield but a particular rank is not established as a pet requirement.
2121.locationType: Chitinbuk skinning farm - rare bonus, not a pet spawn

132518.instructions: Progress the Legion Engineering story with Didi the Wrench in Broken Isles Dalaran (38.6, 25.0) until Short Circuit. Follow its investigation: Rocket-Chief Fuselage in Area 52, Ricket in K3, Chief Engineer Foote in Ratchet, Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan, then Winkey in eastern Tanaris. Borrow Winkey's Diving Helmet and find Gnopetto's underwater workshop and journal off Tanaris. This teaches Blingtron's Circuit Design Tutorial. Craft the toy with 50 Leystone Ore, 50 Felslate and 5 Infernal Brimstone, then use it to add it to the Toy Box. Alternatively, buy the finished toy on the Auction House; using it does not require Engineering.

130254.instructions: Begin Legion Jewelcrafting with Tiffany Cartier in Broken Isles Dalaran (39.9, 34.8) and follow her profession story through Come at Me, Brul and The Charge Within. Jabrul in Stormheim (42.2, 35.0) offers Mysteries of Nature: collect Dragon Glass from the mountainside at 46.7, 31.3 and return it to learn Chatterstone. Craft it with 10 Sangrite, 10 Chaotic Spinel and 1 Blood of Sargeras, then use it to collect the toy. You can also buy the finished toy from another player or the Auction House without Jewelcrafting.

130251.instructions: Follow Tiffany Cartier's Legion Jewelcrafting story through To Dalaran, With Love, then inspect the toy box in the Dalaran jewelry shop (40.0, 35.3) to accept Socket to Me. Collect Crystal Shell from the Truesilver Crab in the Northern Stranglethorn wreck (35.7, 55.9), Crystal Core in Deepholm (51.9, 20.7), Crystal Scale in Twilight Highlands (26.0, 69.7), Crystal Heart from the Golden Hare in Vale of Eternal Blossoms (14.2, 67.2), Crystal Plume in Moonglade (31.0, 47.7), and Crystal Shard inside Highmountain's Greystone Enclave (entrance 54.5, 75.4). Return the components to learn JewelCraft, craft the toy and use it. Buying the finished toy on the Auction House skips the profession chain.
130251.locationType: Toy box - Socket to Me quest start

129961.sourceName: Legion Leatherworking - Pattern: Flaming Hoop / Laura Malley
129961.instructions: Learn Legion Leatherworking, then buy Pattern: Flaming Hoop from Laura Malley in the Broken Isles Dalaran Underbelly (58.0, 58.1) for 100 Sightless Eyes. Earn the currency from Underbelly activities and rare creatures; check whether the sewer guards are present before entering its PvP areas. Learn the pattern, craft Flaming Hoop and use the finished item to add it to the Toy Box. The marker is Laura's recipe shop, not a direct toy purchase. Alternatively, buy the finished toy on the Auction House; Leatherworking is not needed to use it.

129956.instructions: Visit Xur'ios beside the bank in Broken Isles Dalaran (48.8, 13.5) and check his rotating stock for Pattern: Leather Love Seat, priced at 1 Curious Coin. Return on another day if the pattern is absent. Curious Coins are rare rewards from Broken Isles treasures, rare creatures and other Legion reward containers. 129960.instructions: Begin Legion Leatherworking with Namha Moonwater in Broken Isles Dalaran (35.4, 29.6), starting with Skin Deep. Follow her story through Dazed of the Past and Battle Bonds, then accept Playthings. Collect the tanning mixture from the red bottle on the workbench behind Namha. Use the quest workbench recipes in order: 8 Shaved Stonehide Pelts, 8 Tanned Stonehide Leather, 2 Stonehide Leather Linings, 5 Stonehide Leather Strips, then the prototype Stonehide Leather Bed. Turn it in to learn Leather Pet Bed, craft the collectible with 50 Stonehide Leather and 5 Felhide, and use it. Alternatively, buy the finished toy on the Auction House.
129960.locationType: Leather Pet Bed recipe quest / Namha's Workbench

128536.sourceName: Legion Enchanting - Formula: Leylight Brazier / K'huta
128536.instructions: Buy Formula: Leylight Brazier from K'huta in the Broken Isles Dalaran Underbelly (66.0, 79.9) for 250 Sightless Eyes. Gather the currency from Underbelly activities and rare creatures. Learn the formula with Legion Enchanting, then craft Leylight Brazier with 1 Chaos Crystal, 100 Arkhana and 5 Blood of Sargeras. Use the finished item to add it to the Toy Box. The marker identifies the formula vendor. You can instead buy the finished toy from another player or the Auction House without Enchanting.

129211.sourceName: Legion Inscription - The Legacy Passed On / Bill Spearshaker

Bring him the Steamy Romance Novel and accept The Plot Thickens. Find Bill Spearshaker in Ironforge (77.2, 10.4) and complete The Legacy Passed On by interacting with the unfinished book and choosing a complete story. This teaches Steamy Romance Novel Kit; craft the toy and use it to collect it. The finished toy is tradable, so buying it on the Auction House skips Inscription and its quest chain.
129211.locationType: Steamy Romance Novel Kit recipe quest
